topic_label: Commitment to integrity and ethical values
control_description: Employee handbook code of conduct and export compliance program; security commitments in POL-01 and POL-05
evidence: Handbook; POL-01; POL-05; export compliance manual
gap: Policy acknowledgments not yet collected from staff

control_description: President and Vice President of Operations review the program; POA&M reviewed monthly by the Vice President of Operations
gap: No recorded owner-level security review yet
remediation: Quarterly security review with the President, minuted

control_description: Roles, reporting lines, and risk acceptance authority defined in POL-01; Affirming Official named
Background checks and U.S.-person verification at hire; annual general awareness training
gap: No CUI, insider threat, or role-based training

control_description: Sanctions statement in POL-01 4.8; control owners named in the SSP and POA&M
Enclave logs collected; asset inventory in device management
gap: MES, DNC, and firewall logs not collected; OT inventory stale

topic_label: Internal communication of objectives and responsibilities
control_description: Policies approved 2026-08-31; banner on enclave systems
gap: Policies not yet acknowledged by staff

control_description: Security obligations with primes set by DFARS clauses; no security contact or terms for commercial customers and SFTP partners
gap: No SFTP partner terms of use; no security contact published to Customer C
remediation: SFTP terms (POAM-006); security contact letter to Customer C

topic_label: Objectives specified to enable risk identification
control_description: Objectives and risk tolerance in POL-01 and P01
2026 risk assessment per SP 800-30 (P01, 32 risks)
Fraud risk covered only for business email compromise (P01 R-021)
gap: No broader fraud risk assessment (for example, false quality records or misuse of SPRS affirmations)
remediation: Add fraud scenarios to the 2027 risk assessment

control_description: Major changes (MES upgrade, SFTP gateway, virtual desktops) were not assessed for security when made
gap: No security impact analysis for changes
remediation: Change tickets with security review (P01 R-017)

control_description: Independent readiness assessment of 20 controls (P07); annual full self-assessment planned
gap: No continuous monitoring; full self-assessment not yet done

control_description: Deficiencies tracked in the POA&M with owners and dates; monthly review

topic_label: Control activities selected to mitigate risk
control_description: Controls selected from SP 800-171 and SP 800-53 against the risk register
Technology controls defined for cloud; MES and OT controls weak
gap: No documented baselines for VMs and MES

topic_label: Control activities deployed through policies and procedures
control_description: Five policies approved; procedures due 2026-11-30 to 2026-12-31
gap: Supporting procedures not yet written
remediation: Account management, change, and contingency procedures

topic_label: Logical access security software, infrastructure, architecture
control_description: Enclave identity provider with MFA; encryption at rest; segmented enclave
evidence: IdP policy; P04 map; P07 AC-17 and SC-7 (satisfied)
gap: MES shared logins without MFA; FIPS not confirmed on 2 paths

control_description: Manager approval and U.S.-person check before enclave access
Role-based PLM access; admins use just-in-time roles
gap: Departed users' accounts found enabled; no access reviews; engineers have local admin

control_description: Badge access; engineering wing and server room restricted
gap: Visitor escort and log inconsistent on the shop floor

control_description: IT drives wiped with certificates
gap: Printed drawings in general recycling; CNC storage sent out unsanitized

topic_label: Protection against threats from outside boundaries
control_description: Enclave firewall and cloud network security groups; remote access only through the virtual desktop gateway

topic_label: Restriction of data transmission and movement
control_description: Sharing allow-list in the suite; encrypted transfer paths
gap: Public AI and file-sharing sites reachable; outbound allow-any; USB loading of CNC machines

topic_label: Prevention and detection of unauthorized or malicious software
control_description: EDR on enclave endpoints, VMs, MES, and DNC
gap: Allowlisting in audit mode only

topic_label: Detection of configuration changes and vulnerabilities
control_description: No vulnerability scanning; no configuration drift detection
gap: No scanning or baselines

topic_label: Monitoring for anomalies and security events
control_description: EDR alerts reviewed in business hours; logs collected but not reviewed
evidence: EDR queue; P07 SI-4 and AU-6 results
gap: No log review or 24x7 monitoring; no bulk-download detection

control_description: Incident categories and reporting in POL-03
gap: No incident log; no DoD reporting capability yet

control_description: CUI exfiltration runbook (P08) approved, untested
gap: Runbook untested; no forensic retainer

control_description: PLM daily backups; no contingency plan; restores untested
gap: No recovery plan; MES backups weekly and local

control_description: Only named administrators change systems; no change tickets
gap: No change authorization or testing records

control_description: BIA completed (P05); insurance for property and cyber
gap: No contingency plan yet

control_description: Cloud provider FedRAMP authorization and CRM reviewed
gap: Outside processors receive CUI without flowdown or security review
